inputs.name: vhosts
inputs.type:
map(object({
    server_name     = string
    aliases         = optional(list(string), [])
    port            = optional(number)
    document_root   = optional(string)
    proxy_pass      = optional(string)
    tls_certificate = optional(string)
    tls_key         = optional(string)
    extra           = optional(string, "")
  }))
inputs.description: Virtual hosts, by a name of your choosing. Each answers for server_name and aliases on port, and serves files from document_root or proxies to proxy_pass, with TLS when tls_certificate and tls_key are set.

inputs.name: modules
inputs.description: Apache modules to turn on, by name without mod_, such as ["headers", "rewrite"]. proxy, proxy_http and ssl are added when a virtual host needs them.

inputs.name: extra_config
inputs.description: Further Apache directives for the server as a whole, written before the virtual hosts.
